evidence_items.finding: gross profit has not grown despite a 52% revenue increase in the fourteen months since the acquisition
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth without gross profit growth is a critical adverse margin signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the owner has deferred personal salary since the acquisition closed, drawing nothing in fourteen months
evidence_items.rationale: Fourteen months without owner salary post-acquisition is a critical adverse cash signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the acquired business added production capacity that is now shared across both businesses but is running at approximately 65% utilisation
evidence_items.rationale: Shared capacity at 65% utilisation with no margin improvement is an adverse operational signal. operational_efficiency.

evidence_items.finding: acquisition debt of $340K adds $8,200/month in repayments that were not present in the pre-acquisition cost base
evidence_items.rationale: Acquisition debt adding $8,200/month to cost base with no margin improvement is a critical adverse financial signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: commercial printing; 52% revenue growth post-acquisition; flat gross profit; $340K acquisition debt; $8,200/month repayment; 14 months owner salary deferred
Surface signal (not root cause): revenue grew from $680K to $1.04M in fourteen months since the acquisition closed
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth of 52% post-acquisition is a misleading success signal when gross profit has not grown commensurately.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the acquired business's staff have integrated into the combined operation without any departures
evidence_items.rationale: Staff retention post-acquisition is a misleading integration success signal when gross profit and owner salary tell a different story.
